blogs.title: Why LLMs Need Bigger Context Windows – And What Limits Them
blogs.description: An introductory post that explains what a context window is in large language models, why having a larger window matters for real‑world tasks like long‑form summarization or in‑context learning, and the technical roadblocks (position embedding, fine‑tuning cost, and attention dispersion) that have kept windows under ~128k tokens so far.

blogs.title: LongRoPE 101: Extending LLM Context to 2 Million Tokens Without Retraining Everything
blogs.description: A lay‑person’s walkthrough of the LongRoPE methodology – from its core idea of smarter rotary‑position interpolation (RoPE) to how it can push a model’s reach from 4k to 2 048k tokens with only 1k fine‑tuning steps. Includes visuals that demystify “non‑uniform rescaling” and the progressive extension pipeline.

blogs.title: Cracking the Positional Puzzle: How Non‑Uniform Interpolation Beats Linear Tricks
blogs.description: Deep dive into the two key non‑uniformities uncovered by the authors – variation across RoPE dimensions and across token positions. The post explains why simple linear scaling fails, how the evolutionary search discovers optimal per‑dimension scaling factors, and why keeping early tokens untouched improves performance.

blogs.title: From 256k to 2 048k Tokens: The Progressive Fine‑Tuning Shortcut
blogs.description: Explains the three‑stage “progressive extension” strategy that first stretches a model to 256k tokens with evolutionary search, fine‑tunes briefly on that length, then searches again to leap to 2 048k tokens. The article uses analogies (building a ladder one rung at a time) to make the process intuitive for developers.

blogs.title: LongRoPE vs. The Competition: YaRN, PI, NTK and More
blogs.description: A side‑by‑side comparison of LongRoPE with prior context‑extension techniques such as Position Interpolation (PI), NTK‑based scaling, and YaRN. Highlights experimental results (perplexity, passkey retrieval accuracy, benchmark scores) and explains why LongRoPE maintains short‑window performance while scaling up dramatically.

blogs.title: Putting 2 Million Tokens to Work: Real‑World Applications Powered by LongRoPE
blogs.description: Showcases practical use cases enabled by ultra‑long context windows—passkey retrieval from massive documents, multi‑document reasoning for agents, long‑form book summarization, and few‑shot learning across thousands of examples. Includes sample prompts and performance snapshots.

blogs.title: How to Plug LongRoPE Into Your Own LLaMA or Mistral Model
blogs.description: Step‑by‑step guide for practitioners who want to extend their existing RoPE‑based models using LongRoPE. Covers code setup (GitHub repo), preparing short datasets for the 256k fine‑tuning stage, running the evolutionary search, and toggling between short/long contexts at inference time.
